sync_log.summary: Rebased sync tracking onto the canonical public eve-horizon history, whose Initial public release commit does not contain the private-history b5ef3ea baseline. Audited the full public range through cf720e2: July refactors preserve the documented platform surface; the shipped OSS release cutover changes deployment ownership. Updated skillpacks to the three-repo publish-only model, removed repository_dispatch guidance, added canonical-repo guardrails, and made the scheduled source clone credential-free.

41-commit incremental sync — app auth + branding + mailer reliability theme. Distilled 10 shipped capabilities (6 migrations 00093-00098): app-branded invite emails (x-eve.branding), app magic-link login opt-in (x-eve.auth.login_method), app org access + in-app admin invites (POST /auth/app-invites, eve org invite --project --redirect-to), app invite redirect allowlist (x-eve.auth.allowed_redirect_origins), app magic-link domain-signup v2 BREAKING (domain_signup.domains: [{domain, target_org, role}] replaces v1 string list), magic-link confirmation interstitial (wrap tokens, prevents drive-by scanner redemption), SSO SameSite=None on session cookies for custom-domain apps, SES mailer pre-flight suppression check + bounce webhook + email_delivery_events + eve admin email bounces CLI, scoped job token enforcement (workflow/step/invocation scope intersection → jobs.token_scope; axes orgfs/orgdocs/envdb/cloud_fs). Updated 12 reference docs and 4 skills; routing extended with 41 triggers, 11 router lines, 9 intent matrix rows; .sync-map gained 8 reference_docs + 17 skill_triggers entries; 4 composite_triggers watch_sources extended. State-today compliance: PASSED. v1 domain-signup shape NOT documented anywhere (removed where it had been). Note: this sync absorbed the 7 commits flagged as 'queued' in the previous sync.

176-commit incremental sync (largest to date) — distilled across 22 shipped capabilities: per-job harness + env overrides (4 phases, migration 00090, validation endpoint, chat hint propagation, step template expressions, Opus 4.7/GPT-5.5 registered); workflow features (env_overrides, conditional steps, step-level harness, file refs, Slack notifications, resource ref policies, retry tails, step git controls); custom domains (env-scoped first-bind-wins, cert-manager, `eve domain` CLI); deploy error surfacing phases 1-7 (DeployFailure taxonomy, cluster snapshot, applied-release drift, manifest_hash from deploy ref); stable egress hostNetwork v2; embedded app conversations + structured event streams + chat continuity by `thr_*` id; API chat provider; Platform Sentinel (env health monitoring + Slack); LLM Wiki 7 enhancements (near-instant indexing, `eve docs patch/diff/watch/sync/list --tree/search --path,--context/bulk-write`); managed DB TLS trust (verify-full + CA bundle); manifest-driven service tokens (read-only defaults) + auto-inject EVE_SERVICE_TOKEN; SSO self-signup email domain restriction; per-agent envdb wildcard; app bucket credential separation; observability CLI gap closure (env logs --follow/--filter, env diagnose --request, traces query); event→trigger observability; doc.ingest reliability fixes; skills materialization fast-path + `.agents/skills/` canonical + sparse pack support + runtime materialize path; agent learning loop (job.attempt.completed, carryover context, user memory category); job stability (stuck-job prevention, stale recovery, env-gate-only-for-action-jobs, agent-runtime org auto-discovery, chat regex case-insensitive); Eve Dashboard + system app pattern; codex reasoning + harness model normalization. Reference docs updated: 22; skills updated: 11. Routing/index/intent matrix on eve-read-eve-docs SKILL extended with 47 new triggers, 19 router lines, 19 intent rows. Sync-map gained 17 reference_docs + 24 skill_triggers entries. State-today compliance: PASSED. Note: 7 commits landed on eve-horizon during sync execution (branded invite emails, app magic-link login, app org access invites) — these are queued for the next sync.

11-commit incremental sync — documented shipped job observability improvements (heartbeat-aware `eve job diagnose`/`follow`, agent-runtime pod health in CLI output, `eve system status` agent-runtime rendering) and updated the auth skill to recommend unified `eveAuth()`/`eveIdentityGuard()` with stable per-agent identity claims (`agent_slug`, `{agent_slug}@eve.agent`). Cloud FS changes in this range were bug fixes only, so no skillpack updates were needed beyond verification.
